items.t: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Could Be 58% Undervalued Following Its Penguin Solutions Tie Up
items.sum: Marvell Technology (MRVL) has moved into focus after its new collaboration with Penguin Solutions, aimed at tackling AI memory bottlenecks in data centers using CXL-based expansion and photonic interconnect technology. For context, Marvell Technology shares trade at US$130.93, with the stock down 47.97% on a 30-day share price basis and 39.56% over 90 days, yet still showing a 46.47% year to date

items.t: MRVL to Post Q3 Earnings: Time to Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.sum: Marvell heads into Q3 earnings with strong AI infrastructure demand and expanding hyperscaler opportunities, but competition and premium valuation support a Hold stance.

items.t: Why Is Marvell Technology Stock Surging Today?
items.sum: Shares of Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) surged 7. 3% in pre-market trading on Friday after the semiconductor manufacturer reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 results that exceeded Wall Street expectations.

items.t: Marvell Faces Critical Earnings Test Amid AI Chip Market Turmoil
